name: ReadyCraft
tagline: Minecraft inside Ready or Not (single player): walk, build, break and take suspects down with Minecraft's weapons, taking bullets on Minecraft's hearts (SkyCraft's Fabric mod).

games.label: Ready or Not
games.engine: Ready or Not (Unreal Engine 5.3.2, DirectX 12) + version.dll proxy and C++ mod DLL

requires.note: in the Minecraft pack (downloaded from Modrinth)

notes: How it works: Minecraft runs hidden next to Ready or Not and takes over the officer: you walk, build, break and take suspects down with Minecraft's weapons and TNT inside the game's levels, and the game's bullets come off Minecraft's hearts. The officer's own guns are put away.

Press Play: Minecraft starts first, then Ready or Not with -slnoswapchainprovider. Go into Singleplayer and wait about 30 seconds: Minecraft's hotbar appears when it is ready. Choose a mission at the briefing desk with F as usual. You do not need SkyCraft or Skyrim.

Keys: WASD/Space/Shift move, left click break/hit, right click place/use, 1-9 hotbar, E inventory, T chat, F5 third person, O Minecraft menu. F is the game's use key (doors, cuffing, evidence), Esc pause. Hold Left Alt to be the officer for a moment; F10 hands him back fully.

Ready or Not on Steam at build 24942528, on DirectX 12 (its default), and Minecraft: Java Edition. Starting it outside the app needs -slnoswapchainprovider in Steam launch options or it crashes about 30 s in. NVIDIA Frame Generation is off while it runs; DLSS upscaling works.

Single player only: never take it into public multiplayer. After a game update the mod does nothing until a new release: press Restore until then. Run one "Minecraft X" mod at a time. Restore removes version.dll and ReadyCraft.dll from ReadyOrNot\Binaries\Win64.

Early build, a few short runs on one PC. Known gaps: doors are not solid, blocks are drawn over everything, people do not flinch, your team cannot be hurt. Report bugs to the author on the upstream issue tracker with %LOCALAPPDATA%\ReadyCraft\readycraft.log.
